cues: To tell them apart in one line each: sodium hydroxide dissolves phenol but not ethanol.
Sodium bicarbonate fizzes only with a carboxylic acid.
And neutral ferric chloride turns violet only with phenol.
text: To tell them apart in one line each: sodium hydroxide dissolves phenol but not ethanol. Sodium bicarbonate fizzes only with a carboxylic acid. And neutral ferric chloride turns violet only with phenol.
